entities.name: Odet of Foix, Viscount of Lautrec
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Odet de Foix, Vicomte de Lautrec was a French military leader. As Marshal of France, he commanded the campaign to conquer Naples, but died from the bubonic plague in 1528.
